Reorient the form vertically. Stack the smaller ellipse above the larger one and overlap them to establish a narrow waist. Place the rounded trapezoid at the top.
Merge the overlapping contours and smooth the waist into a continuous gourd shape. Remove construction lines and standardize the stroke. Keep only the bill-base curve and two small nostril marks.
